finding: The after-cursor backward pagination in probe_okx_funding() is correctly implemented: cursor is set to min(fundingTime) from each page and used as the after parameter on the next request. The page_not_full stop condition (len(rows) < 400) correctly identifies when the API has returned all available data. No pagination bug was found.
structural_limitation: The OKX public/funding-rate-history endpoint is structurally limited to ~90 days of funding rate history (documented as 'up to three months'). The after cursor is correctly used to page backward, but the server has no records older than ~90 days, so pagination terminates with page_not_full on the first page. This is a server-side data retention limitation, not a client-side pagination defect. The after cursor cannot extend beyond the ~90-day window because no older records exist on the server.
impact: OKX funding-rate-history is the limiting factor for the cross-venue funding dispersion exploratory track. The ~97-day common overlap (2026-07-20 to 2026-10-25) is short of the >=3-year confirmatory requirement. The exploratory FVD053 anchor found 0 signals across 47 candidate dates (INCONCLUSIVE).
